name: Streaming answer
description: An assistant's answer streaming in: the prompt in a bubble, a moment of thinking dots, then the reply arriving word by word, each fading up, with a caret while it writes.

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.default: Cut this interview into a 30-second teaser

response.label: Reply
response.default: Done. I kept the three strongest answers, trimmed the pauses, put the hook first and timed the cuts to the music. Captions are on and the colour matches your last video.
